deploy-bot: [2026-03-20 10:02:23 UTC] Rollback initiated: revert deploy tag 'v1.6.2' -> 'v1.6.1' on prod-eu2

Commit: 4f9b2c8

maria: seeing 502/timeout spike across canaries, good call. Thanks deploy-bot.

alex: will pin v1.6.1 on the upgrade group after rollback completes. Who's owning verification?

sre-oncall: I'll watch metrics and smoke tests. @qa-ana pls hold off new releases to eu2 for 30m.

qa-ana: ack, running smoke: kv-cache, streaming, latencies. Will post pass/fail.

ci-cd-bot: Revert deploy started: pipeline #build-1862 -> rollback:v1.6.2->v1.6.1
Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1862

maria: if rollback fails we should failover to eu1 region. mark for oncall-runbook

ryan: applied pin with curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/dedicated/pins \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"env":"prod-eu2","model":"runtime","tag":"v1.6.1","reason":"emergency-rollback-2019876543"}'
```

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: deploy group 'runtime-prod-eu2' now running tag v1.6.1
Duration: 2m 42s
Fallbacks: none used

sre-oncall: metrics looking stable. error-rate back to baseline 0.8% over 5m. smoke tests PASS.

alex: thanks. I'll update the release notes and create a postmortem if root cause is confirmed.

maria: opened incident ticket INC-2026-098: investigating model runtime regression in v1.6.2

qa-ana: re-run full regression in staging, will post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: Note: automated alert unsubscribed for this thread. If you need followups, ping #incidents or @oncall.

ryan: one more thing — we should schedule a patch rollback window tomorrow 0300 UTC to test the hotfix rollout.

alex: noted. assigning to @maria to coordinate.

maria: on it, will create calendar invite and link to patch branch.
